column1: # Certified 128-bit directed exp/log/atan oracle, replacing runtime independent exact arithmetic references.
# kind original_num original_den down_num down_den up_num up_den
# Preserves the 24 exact original inputs and 48 strict comparisons of test_rounded_float.
# Generated by integer-only interval arithmetic using B=2^1400 fixed point.
# exp: 241 Taylor terms on |x|/16 + 2*next term; four outward squarings;
# negative inputs use outward reciprocal. Bound exp(1/8)<2 establishes tail.
# log: 271 positive atanh terms in y=|x-1|/(x+1), plus 4*y^543 tail.
# atan: 271 alternating Taylor terms + next term bound; reduce near +/-1
# via pi/4 + atan((abs(x)-1)/(abs(x)+1)), where pi/4 is certified
# from 4*atan(1/5)-atan(1/239) using the same integer intervals.
# The 128-bit DOWN and UP rounding of both interval endpoints must coincide.
# No FloatAP, independent exact arithmetic, independent exact arithmetic, GMP or floating-point transcendentals as oracle.
# FloatDP output is checked strictly > 128-bit upper or < 128-bit lower,
# matching the original tests; NOT for equality at 53-bit precision.
